fails a new entry and a stale one, so the lists only shrink as each cluster moves to its owner (follow-up cards:
chat tools, client hub, hiring, company goals, gallery, own-service writes). `funnels` is not part of the

team.lib/data.ts: teamRead and assertInScope: the scope rule for the team hub reads (SCOPE_ALLOWLIST), kept in one place because a single unscoped query would leak the whole company (PR #2120).
